title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.36114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents are judged by two numbers: the size of the context window, and how often the final answer is correct. Both numbers miss a third thing: how much of a tool's output is lost before the model ever sees it. We measured this loss in a real tool-using agent. The agent finds the cause of injected faults by reading Linux kernel traces. The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. The harness cut each result by slicing its JSON text at a fixed length. This does not shorten a result evenly. It deletes whatever data sits near the end. One field reached the model in only 4.7% of calls. A second field, in the very same results, reached the model in 99.3% of calls. translated_title: 上下文是一条流水线，而非一扇窗口：LLM智能体框架中的信息损耗
translated_abstract: 人们通常用两个数字来评判LLM智能体：上下文窗口的大小，以及最终答案的正确率。但这两个数字都忽略了第三件事：工具的输出在模型看到之前损失了多少。我们在一个真实的工具使用型智能体中测量了这种损耗。该智能体通过读取Linux内核跟踪记录来查找注入故障的原因。上下文窗口几乎是空的：在720次运行中，单个最大的提示词仅占用了窗口的5.75%。然而，三分之一的工具结果（11,189个中的3,827个）在到达模型之前就被截断了，而且每一个被截断的结果都变成了损坏的JSON。该框架通过在固定长度处切分JSON文本来截断每个结果，这并不会均匀地缩短结果，而是删除了位于末尾附近的任何数据。其中一个字段仅在4.7%的调用中到达模型，而在完全相同的结果中，另一个字段在99.3%的调用中到达模型。哪个字段包含故障的证据取决于故障进程启动的时间：早期……
tldr: 该研究揭示了一个被忽视的关键问题：即使LLM智能体的上下文窗口利用率仅为5.75%，智能体框架仍会通过固定长度切分JSON的方式截断三分之一的工具结果，导致末尾数据不均匀丢失，使不同字段到达模型的比例差异悬殊（4.7%对99.3%），因此评估智能体不能只看窗口大小和答案正确率，还必须关注“信息损耗”。
en_tdlr: Even with a nearly empty context window (max 5.75% utilization), LLM agent harnesses cut a third of tool results via fixed-length JSON slicing, which unevenly deletes end-of-text data and causes field survival rates to vary drastically (4.7% vs. 99.3%), exposing information attrition as a critical third metric beyond window size and answer accuracy.
